THE HONOURABLE SMT JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI CRIMINAL PETITION NO: 3444 OF 2020 Between:
Sri |. Kondala Rao, S/o Suryanarayana ,

.... Petitioner/Accused No.1.
AND The State of Andhra Pradesh, Through the S.H.O., of Ill Town P.S., Visakhapatnam Rep., by its Public Prosecutor High Court of A.P.., at Amaravathi.

... Respondent/Complainant Petition under Section 438 of Cr.P.C, praying that in the circumstances stated in the grounds filed in support of the Criminal Petition, the High Court may be pleased to pass an order to enlarge the petitioner A.1. on anticipatory bail in FIR No. 588/2020 dated 0 07-2020 by directing the SHO, of Ill Town P.S Visakhapatnam to release the petitioner/A.1 in the event of his arrest.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the grounds filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of Sri R Siva Sai Swarup Advocate for the Petitioner, and of Public Prosecutor for the Respondent and the Court made the following.
ORDER ial THE HON'BLE SMT. JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI CRIMINAL PETITION NO.3444 of 2020 ORDER:-

This petition is filed under Sections 438 of Code of the Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') seeking anticipatory bail to the petitioner/A-1 in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.588 of 2020, dated 02.07.2020 of Station House Officer, III Town Police Station, 270, 273, 328 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
Sri I. Kondala Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 4 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63330463/
1 1860(for short IPC', Section 20(b) r/w 8(c) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (for short 'NDPS Act) and Sections 59(i) and 59(ii) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'FSS Act'.
2. Heard Sri Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3. The case of prosecution is that the Inspector of Police, Ill Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam City on 02.07.2020 on receipt of information about the transportation of Tobacco products rushed to ENT Hospital, Visakhapatnam and found one person going on TVS Motor cycle on seeing the police, he tried to escape.

sentences.text: Then the police caught hoid of the said person and asked about the details and A-3 confessed that he used to supply tobacco products from like Gutkha, Khainee etc., to all kirana shops and used to buy tobacco products from the petitioner / A-1 and other accused.
Basing on the confessional statement of A-3, the police registered a crime and added the petitioner as Accused No.1.

To arkWnN>
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in respect of other crimes under IPC, COTP Act and FSS Act, this Court has already quashed the proceedings in FIR No.588 of 2020 vide order dated 22.07.2020 in Crl.P.No.2767 of 2020.

Learned counsel further submits that only basing on the confessional statement of A-3, the petitioner/A-1 was implicated in the crime, except that, there is no material to show that the petitioner/A-1 was involved in the crime.
The learned counsel submits that only 4 KGs of ganja is seized from A-3 which is not a commercial quantity.
5. The learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application. '

6. However, taking into consideration the fact that the offences against the petitioner /A-1 | was in respect of other offences was already quashed by this Court and the contraband seized is 4 Kgs which is not a commercial quantity
, this Court feels that it is a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner/A-1. .
7. Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is allowed.
The petitioner / A-1 shall be enlarged on bail on execution of self bond.
of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand only) with two sureties for a like sum each to the satisfaction of the IV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Visakhapatnam.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
